verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI without SQL (hightouch-docs-1, hightouch-docs-24, hightouch-docs-35, hightouch-docs-54), and Customer Studio is described as the self-serve interface for marketers to build audiences and activate data. However, no evidence describes an estimated audience size preview before activation. missing for 10: audience size estimation/preview feature, independent hands-on confirmation of the visual builder's no-SQL experience.
